description: Resolves the target directory for repo synchronization and folder date operations. Priority: positional CLI argument > TARGET_PATH env var (with quote stripping) > default <repo>/starred_repos. Shared stripQuotes utility removes surrounding quotes and whitespace from env var values.
notes: Backfilled by feature-coverage-audit from current implementation evidence on 2026-06-10.
Duplication eliminated via src/lib/cli-utils.ts (folded reorg audit finding, consolidated 2026-06-11).

Revision 1.1.0 (2026-06-11): TARGET_PATH parsing unified (trim + quote strip) and default path standardized to <repo>/starred_repos for both scripts; stripQuotes/resolveTargetPath extracted to shared src/lib/cli-utils.ts.
spec:
1. Verify a positional target-path argument overrides both TARGET_PATH env var and default.
2. Verify TARGET_PATH env var (with surrounding quotes) is used when no positional argument is given.
3. Verify the default path <repo>/starred_repos is used when neither positional argument nor env var is provided.
4. Verify stripQuotes removes surrounding single quotes, double quotes, and leading/trailing whitespace.
5. Verify stripQuotes and resolveTargetPath are implemented once in src/lib/cli-utils.ts and imported by both src/index.ts (which re-exports them for backward compatibility) and scripts/set-folder-dates.ts — do NOT duplicate these utilities.
title: Target Path Resolution
